name: Adhere
description: An object is covered in extremely sticky slime.
quirk: Adjacent objects stick to the book with great force.

name: Anchor
description: A strong wire sprouts from your arms, affixing itself to two points within 50ft on each side.
quirk: If a rope is pulled through the iron loop on its spine, it becomes as heavy as an elephant.

name: Animate Object
description: An object obeys your commands as best it can.
quirk: Moldable like clay. Childish laughter sprouts from its pages.

name: Anthropomorphize
description: An animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for one day.
quirk: Whimpers, purrs and growls depending on its treatment.

name: Arcane Eye
description: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command.
quirk: Needs a spritz of water to open.

name: Astral Prison
description: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell.
quirk: Silent, abstract, faces scream in anguish within.

name: Attract
description: Two objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet.
quirk: Nearby compasses spin uselessly.

name: Auditory Illusion
description: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice.
quirk: Produces random and occasionally inopportune sounds throughout the day.

name: Babble
description: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute.
quirk: When the text is read aloud, the words of others become unintelligible.

name: Bait Flower
description: A plant sprouts from the ground that emanates the smell of decaying flesh.
quirk: Attracts flies.

name: Beast Form
description: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal.
quirk: Covered in thick fur, its edges lined with small teeth.

name: Befuddle
description: A creature of your choice is unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell.
quirk: Its contents shift and change each time it is opened.

name: Body Swap
description: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well.
quirk: The front cover shows an image of the last creature to read it.

name: Charm
description: A creature you can see treats you as a friend.
quirk: Warm to the touch, and smells of roses.

name: Command
description: A target obeys a single three-word command that does not cause it harm.
quirk: Grows thinner over time, until finally disappearing forever.

name: Comprehend
description: You become fluent in all languages for a short while.
quirk: Drips letters, staining whatever it touches.

name: Cone of Foam
description: Dense foam sprays from your hand, coating the target.
quirk: Spongy and moist with a soapy residue.

name: Control Plants
description: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at a slow pace.
quirk: Leaves grow along the spine, and it smells faintly of decay.

name: Control Weather
description: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it.
quirk: Highly resistant to fire and water damage.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Restore 1d4 STR per day to a creature you can touch.
quirk: Smells of vinegar and thyme. Turns red after use.

name: Deafen
description: All nearby creatures are deafened.
quirk: Nearby instruments occasionally sound off, as if in protest.

name: Detect Magic
description: You can see or hear nearby magical auras.
quirk: Becomes warm to the touch if magic is used nearby.

name: Disassemble
description: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them.
quirk: Regenerates any torn or defaced pages.

name: Disguise
description: You may alter the appearance of one character at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny.
quirk: The surface makes a perfect mirror.

name: Displace
description: An object appears to be up to 15ft from its actual position.
quirk: Bits of string, clothing, and leaves are sometimes stuffed inside.

name: Earthquake
description: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse.
quirk: Sand dribbles from the corners, seemingly without stop.

name: Elasticity
description: Your body can stretch up to 10ft.
quirk: Smells of taffy, and is very flexible.

name: Elemental Wall
description: A straight wall of ice or fire 50ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground.
quirk: Skin and warmer substances stick to it after use.

name: Filch
description: A visible item teleports to your hands.
quirk: An ally's prized possession may occasionally be found tucked between its covers.

name: Fish Lung
description: A target can breathe underwater until they surface again.
quirk: Smells strongly of the sea. Attracts wild animals.

name: Flare
description: A bright ball of energy fires a trail of light into the sky, revealing your location to friend or foe.
quirk: Faintly glows in complete darkness.

name: Fog Cloud
description: A dense fog spreads out from you.
quirk: When submersed in water, the book eventually turns all the liquid to vapor.

name: Frenzy
description: A nearby creature erupts in a frenzy of violence.
quirk: Rough, sandpaper cover that destroys any book it touches.

name: Gate
description: A portal to a random plane opens.
quirk: A large hole is carved into the center, ending in a void. Items dropped within are never seen again.

name: Gravity Shift
description: You can change the direction of gravity, but only for yourself.
quirk: Attaches itself to the largest object nearby.

name: Greed
description: A creature develops the overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice.
quirk: The cover changes depending on the owner, subtly hinting at their deepest desires.

name: Haste
description: Your movement speed is tripled.
quirk: Pages flip wildly while open. Can cause paper cuts.

name: Hatred
description: A creature develops a deep hatred of another creature or group and wishes to destroy them.
quirk: Long term exposure to the book can cause suspicion, paranoia and distrust of others.

name: Hear Whispers
description: You can hear faint sounds clearly.
quirk: The reader's voice is amplified for a short period of time afterwards.

name: Hover
description: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to one humanoid.
quirk: Floats if dropped.

name: Hypnotize
description: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer one yes or no question you ask it.
quirk: Eye-catching, swirling spirals don its covers.

name: Icy Touch
description: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to 10ft in radius.
quirk: Gloves required. Nonflammable.

name: Identify Owner
description: Letters appear over the object you touch, spelling out the name of the object’s owners, if there are any.
quirk: The book's interior lists the name of its previous owner.

name: Illuminate
description: A floating light moves as you command.
quirk: When held in light, the pages become a prism of vibrant rainbows.

name: Invisible Tether
description: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart.
quirk: Its pages are not attached by glue or thread, yet stay together nonetheless.

name: Knock
description: A nearby mundane or magical lock unlocks loudly.
quirk: Locked. A new owner "produces" the key after their next meal.

name: Leap
description: You jump up to 10ft high, once.
quirk: When thrown, it just keeps going.

name: Liquid Air
description: The air around you becomes swimmable.
quirk: Floats of its own volition, bouncing off of whatever it touches.

name: Magic Dampener
description: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved.
quirk: Relics within 100ft of the spellbook cannot be recharged.

name: Manse
description: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will.
quirk: If left inside, both the book and the cottage vanish forever.

name: Marble Craze
description: Your pockets are full of marbles and will refill every 30 seconds.
quirk: When jostled, makes a playful rattling sound.

name: Masquerade
description: A character's appearance and voice becomes identical to those of a character you touch.
quirk: Extended use causes the owner to develop unconscious yet noticeable tics.

name: Miniaturize
description: A creature you touch is shrunk down to the size of a mouse.
quirk: The text is ludicrously, comically large.

name: Mirror Image
description: An illusory duplicate of yourself appears and is under your control.
quirk: Over time, the owner begins to question who is the original, and who is the duplicate.

name: Mirrorwalk
description: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today.
quirk: Will not open unless the owner politely knocks on the cover.

name: Multiarm
description: You temporarily gain an extra arm.
quirk: After use, the caster is wracked with phantom limb syndrome for a day.

name: Night Sphere
description: A 50ft-wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears before you.
quirk: Displays a prominent constellation on its cover.

name: Objectify
description: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple.
quirk: The owner experiences intense pareidolia for days after use.

name: Ooze Form
description: You become a living jelly.
quirk: Slowly drips an acid that eventually eats away anything it touches.

name: Pacify
description: A creature near you has an aversion to violence.
quirk: Smells of jasmine and incense. Attracts children.

name: Passage
description: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick.
quirk: An object dropped on top of the book inevitably falls through the other side.

name: Phobia
description: A nearby creature becomes terrified of an object of your choice.
quirk: Over time, haunting, abstract art begins to fill its pages.

name: Pit
description: A pit 10ft wide and 10ft deep opens in the ground.
quirk: A standard piton can be safely stored in its spine.

name: Primal Surge
description: A creature rapidly evolves into a future version of its species.
quirk: The owner is haunted by strange visions of their own ancestors.

name: Push/Pull
description: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you or pushed directly away from you with the strength of one man.
quirk: Any force against the book is comically amplified.

name: Raise Dead
description: A skeleton rises from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders.
quirk: The owner becomes more and more fascinated with bones after each use.

name: Raise Spirit
description: The spirit of a nearby corpse manifests and will answer 1 question.
quirk: The answers (but not their questions) are forever inscribed in its pages.

name: Read Mind
description: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures.
quirk: Long-term possession can cause the reader to mistake the thoughts of others as their own.

name: Repel
description: Two objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other within 10 feet.
quirk: Closed by two powerful straps that spring open at inopportune times.

name: Scry
description: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today.
quirk: The owner's eyes turn milky-white for an hour after use.

name: Sculpt Elements
description: Inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands.
quirk: Slowly decays on contact with wood or cloth. Bury in dirt or submerge in water to refresh.

name: Sense
description: Choose one kind of object (key, gold, arrow, jug, etc). You can sense the nearest example.
quirk: The book's previous owner is always aware of the book's current location.

name: Shield
description: A creature you touch is protected from mundane attacks for one minute.
quirk: Bound in rusty ring-mail and is quite heavy. If held, provides +1 Armor.

name: Shroud
description: A creature you touch is invisible until they move.
quirk: Invisible to any but the book's current owner.

name: Shuffle
description: Two creatures you can see instantly switch places.
quirk: If stolen but not yet read, it reappears wherever its owner last left it.

name: Skillful Repair
description: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object.
quirk: Sewn from the vellum of one hundred books, no two pages are alike.

name: Sleep
description: A creature you can see falls into a light sleep.
quirk: Soft as a pillow, but yields only fitful sleep.

name: Slick
description: Every surface in a 30ft radius becomes extremely slippery.
quirk: Gloves are required for handling, lest the book is dropped in a most comical fashion.

name: Smoke Form
description: Your body becomes a living smoke that you can control.
quirk: Smells of campfire. The pages cannot be burnt, but are very sensitive to moisture.

name: Sniff
description: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents.
quirk: Expresses a strong odor detectable only by its owner.

name: Snuff
description: The source of any mundane light you can see is instantly snuffed out.
quirk: If left in one place for long periods, nearby light sources eventually dim, then finally go out.

name: Sort
description: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set.
quirk: Rights itself when dropped or thrown.

name: Spellsaw
description: A whirling blade flies from your chest, clearing any plant material in its way. It is otherwise harmless.
quirk: Wrapped in stained leather, it should be oiled at least once a month.

name: Spider Climb
description: You can climb surfaces like a spider.
quirk: New cobwebs must be pushed aside prior to each use. They are hard to remove.

name: Swarm
description: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You can only be harmed by _blast_ attacks.
quirk: Easily broken into a dozen distinct parts that slowly move towards one another over time.

name: Target Lure
description: An object you touch becomes the target of any nearby spell.
quirk: Attracts all manner of magical creatures, spell leaks, and scrying.

name: Telekinesis
description: You may mentally 1 move item under 60lbs.
quirk: The owner can summon the book through mental command alone (WIL save or become deprived afterwards).

name: Telepathy
description: Two creatures can hear each other’s thoughts, no matter how far apart.
quirk: The holder can hear (but not respond) to the thoughts of whoever last possessed it, and vice versa.

name: Teleport
description: An object or person you can see is transported from one place to another in a 50ft radius.
quirk: Can be destroyed to create a portal to another dimension.

name: Thicket
description: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to 50ft wide suddenly sprouts up.
quirk: Wrapped in vines that must be destroyed again with each use.

name: Time Control
description: Time in a 50ft bubble slows down or increases by 10% for 30 seconds.
quirk: Alternates its appearance as either impossibly old or freshly written.

name: True Sight
description: You see through all nearby illusions.
quirk: Cannot be concealed by magic, and sticks out like a sore thumb.

name: Upwell
description: A spring of seawater appears.
quirk: Hardened leather bindings caked in salt and living barnacles.

name: Vision
description: You completely control what a creature sees.
quirk: An unnerving, lidless eye graces the front cover.

name: Visual Illusion
description: A silent, immobile, room-sized illusion of your choice appears.
quirk: Filled with rich, colorful pages very much like a children's bedtime story.

name: Ward
description: A silver circle 50ft across appears on the ground. Choose one species that cannot cross it.
quirk: The covers are decorated with bizarre, otherworldly creatures with thousands of eyes.

name: Web
description: Your wrists shoot thick webbing.
quirk: The text is alien, yet somehow intelligible, for it is the language of dreams.

name: Widget
description: A primitive version of a drawn tool or item appears before you and disappears after a short time.
quirk: Smells of iron and rust, sweat and effort. Faint sounds of harsh labor emanate from deep within its pages.

name: Wizard Mark
description: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects.
quirk: Inside the front cover is a small pocket containing a thin pad of paper, listing the name and date of death of all previous owners.

name: X-Ray Vision
description: You can see through walls, dirt, clothing, etc.
quirk: Long-term exposure can cause hair loss, blurry vision, and fatigue.
